facts.fact: The APDPVP's own release says its September 2025 inspections were carried out under law no. 025/2023 of 12 July 2023 on personal data protection, citing its articles 201 and 78.
The APDPVP says in its release that its sworn agents carried out compliance inspections on 12 to 18 September 2025 in Port-Gentil.
facts.system: Autorite pour la Protection des Donnees Personnelles et de la Vie Privee (APDPVP)

facts.fact: The APDPVP says its agents checked ten oil firms in Port-Gentil from 12 to 18 September 2025 and found they run processing without the declarations the law requires, with no sanction mentioned.
